- **Cut at the outer corner (diagonal vertex):** Unfolding replicates this notch at all four diagonal vertices of the octagon, turning the outline into a four-lobed cross shape (points at top, bottom, left, right).
- **Cut at the center corner, perpendicular to the straight (fold) edge:** Unfolding replicates this right-triangle cut 8 times around the center. The mirrored cuts line up into straight lines parallel to the axes, producing a **square hole** in the middle.
